inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: It’s a failure of public responsibility when communities must rally just to protect a shared watershed from coal exploration. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is asking Alberta’s government to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This is about more than one campaign: people’s water and livelihoods should not be sacrificed to industry, while the burden of resisting extraction is pushed onto those who face its risks. Government should protect the public, not leave residents to fight for basic safeguards.
